answer: Require each registration to include a hash from one of the last few blocks, proving it was made moments ago and not precomputed months earlier. An ember from last winter cannot warm today's hands, and a raven that claims to have flown yesterday must show today's sky. A ledge of fakes all citing the same block shows they were minted in one batch, because the chain moves on and a registration citing a stale hash is rejected. A farm cannot stockpile identities for later.
